Polysorbate 80 is known to interact with Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, indicating a possible pathway through which Tilmicosin may influence this transporter. Additionally, Tilmicosin is predicted to interact with Forkhead box protein O1, which is targeted by a complex molecular structure. This second pathway also leads to the same target, Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The integration of these two distinct targets suggests that Tilmicosin may exert its effects through multiple mechanisms, potentially modulating the activity of the transporter in different cellular contexts. The evidence supports a plausible but indirect relationship, with the strength of the connection being moderate, as indicated by the final scores. The mechanisms involve interactions with ion channels and transporters, highlighting the complexity of drug-target interactions in this biological context.
